speaker: Doctor
text: I see you're experiencing a chronic cough and shortness of breath; to better understand what's going on, how long has this cough been persisting, and does it produce any phlegm or blood? REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray to check for structural abnormalities.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the X-ray results; the hyperinflation and flattened diaphragms suggest air trapping. Does your breathing difficulty worsen with exertion, and do you have a history of smoking or exposure to dust? REQUEST TEST: Spirometry to assess lung function and confirm obstruction.
